source_metadata.etymology_text:
From Old Galician-Portuguese estar, from Latin stāre (“stand”).
The stems estev- or estiv- found in some inflections likely come from Vulgar Latin *stēvī (perfect in -ēv-, used by some Latin second conjugation verbs), hypothetical perfect stem that displaced original Classical Latin perfect stetī. Compare the same development in Spanish estar. The present subjunctive stem estej- is by analogy with ser, sej- (which is from Latin sedēre).

sense_provider_metadata.etymology_text:
From Old Galician-Portuguese estar, from Latin stāre (“stand”).
The stems estev- or estiv- found in some inflections likely come from Vulgar Latin *stēvī (perfect in -ēv-, used by some Latin second conjugation verbs), hypothetical perfect stem that displaced original Classical Latin perfect stetī. Compare the same development in Spanish estar. The present subjunctive stem estej- is by analogy with ser, sej- (which is from Latin sedēre).

source_metadata.etymology_text: Genericized trademark from Ninho, a powdered milk brand owned by Nestlé. Literally, “nest milk”.

examples.english: My dogs are 17 years old now. They were raised by me with powdered milk.
examples.ref: 1974 October 28, José Antônio da Silva, Romildo Sant'Anna, “O temperamento de José Antônio da Silva”, in Silva: quadros e livros: um artista caipira (Studium), São José do Rio Preto: Unesp, published 1993, →ISBN, page 22:
examples.text: Meus cachorros que Estão agora com a idade de 17 anos. Foram criados por mim com leite ninho.
examples.translation: My dogs are 17 years old now. They were raised by me with powdered milk.

examples.english: The novelty in another ice cream shop of the city is the Italian biscuit ice cream. “We also have light ice cream, truffled powdered milk and also for those that like some alcoholic beverage”, says the owner.
examples.ref: 2012 January 2, Lynne Aranha, quoting Angelo Florêncio Marini, “Sorveterias de Itapetininga, SP, apostam em novos sabores”, in G1, Itapetininga: Globo, archived from the original on 23 Feb 2025:
examples.text: A novidade em outra sorveteria do município é o sorvete de biscoito com origem italiana. “Também temos o sorvete light, o de leite ninho trufado e também para aqueles que gostam de uma bebida alcóolica.[…]”, diz o dono.
examples.translation: The novelty in another ice cream shop of the city is the Italian biscuit ice cream. “We also have light ice cream, truffled powdered milk and also for those that like some alcoholic beverage”, says the owner.

examples.english: Pour the powdered milk mousse over the hazel, cocoa and milk cream and refrigerate it for at least 2 hours.

examples.text: Coloque a mousse de leite ninho por cima do de creme de avelã com cacau e leite e leve para gelar pôr^([sic – meaning por]) no mínimo 2 horas.
examples.translation: Pour the powdered milk mousse over the hazel, cocoa and milk cream and refrigerate it for at least 2 hours.
